path_rule: Original-record paths are relative to topic; external catalog paths starting topics/ are repository-relative.
scope: Only 32 generated TailClient pre-Popen identity descriptions; all 32 full runtime configs and all matching original input configs are retained at their existing paths.

reconstruction.rule: For each row, merge common_fields with fields, and merge common_source_sha256 with fields.source_sha256 to obtain the original source_sha256 object. All original parsed JSON fields are retained. Exact historical wrapper bytes are restored from the fixed Git blob, not from reserialization.
reconstruction.command_scope: The command field is exactly the command recorded before subprocess.Popen. Some original callers inserted a hook in observed_popen; this field alone is not relabeled as that augmented actual command. Full actual commands and caller source remain in retained run catalogs.
reconstruction.false_flag_scope: actual_nonlinear_solve_started=false was written before launching the worker; it does not assert that the subsequent original run never computed, failed or succeeded.

common_fields.input_manifest_scope: Public numerical subset only: 78 of the original 91 files. Twelve other-topic Markdown references and one unconsumed prefix-tail solver client are omitted. Every consumed restored file retains its original SHA-256 check.
common_fields.scope:
Persistent public-repository true tail DN with an explicit mode capacity.

TailClient(config_path, source_root, record_prefix, node_heap=1536) exposes
solve(H,jacobian=True,audit=False), cut, sources, linearD, ready, and close().
It calls the existing frozen-original-metric nonlinear worker and records
each complete response.  The only added numerical-source transformation is
the three SHA-locked constructor mode ceilings in the Node loader.  The
source second-jet differences, analytic first-slope/mean-slope replacement,
Newton acceptance and full requested audit remain in their original paths.

The constructor never substitutes a principal projector or an affine DN.
Repeated identical unaudited requests may reuse an already solved response.
An audited request is always sent to the actual worker.  All computations
belong to Rogerhu12/math-research-public GitHub Actions.
